gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-old-ital: Old signboard punch, no apology. Woodgod's wide-channeled bowls stand tall up top, and Noto Sans Old Italic follows with curve endings held apart and capitals barely above the lowercase, so paragraphs move along briskly.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-numans: Vintage muscle meets modern breathing room. The standout quality is how Woodgod's tall, tight-bowled lowercase sits against Numans, whose s ends hang far from the spine and whose tracking runs well past normal.
